status: FROZEN BEFORE TIMING; execution authorized by independent review, no promotion
purpose: Recover the original C1 opt-out regression versus original-before and current-unmodified images, with enabled C1/interpreter/C2/tiered safety controls. One bounded comparison, no tuning/retry-until-pass.
calibration_identity: Current and calibration are independent fresh forks of the exact same image path and bytes; labels only, no patch module or different build.

ordinary.description: Existing1024-value seeded mixed ordinary positive input set, original regression target.

short.description: Existing1024 seeded integer-valued doubles in[0,999]; variable short inputs, includes zero. No new distribution.

full-range.description: Existing1024 seeded finite raw-bit doubles, both signs and full exponent range, including large magnitudes. Not a large-only population.

long_protocol.profiler: gc only; no WhiteBox/phase profiler/assembly/compilation logging in timed forks

phases.name: A-long-calibration-and-primary
phases.gate_after: Analyze only calibration/current equivalence. If it fails, stop all further runtime qualification, retain all32 forks and report repair contrasts descriptively. No retries.

phases.name: D-exact-historical-short-protocol
phases.reason: Separate supporting replication of the exact original short endpoint; does not replace adequate long primary batches. Its own recovery/control gates must pass.

statistics: Whole-fork paired log ratios.16fixed one-sided95% familywise t upper bounds at p=1-.05/16, df=n-1. Report nominal paired two-sided95% intervals, all individual forks and every measured iteration. No short/long pooling, selected-iteration substitution or outlier deletion.
regression_guards: Every repair/current or repair/before comparison: nominal paired95% interval wholly above0 is failure; positive geometric point with more than half pairs slower is HOLD; exact one-sided slowdown sign-test p<=.05 is failure, exact ties excluded. Report every positive point/slower count. The1% safety bound never accepts established/consistent loss.
calibration_gates: Long and historical cohorts separately: calibration/current paired two-sided95% interval must fit[-1,+1]% AND contain0; exact two-sided sign-test p<=.05 blocks qualification. Long gate is evaluated after phaseA, without inspecting repair/before performance. Failed calibration cannot excuse candidate losses. Historical gate is evaluated only after the fixed remaining observations.
allocation_gates: All12 repair/current cells and four repair/before cohorts: whole-fork paired arithmetic B/op delta one-sided95% upper must be<0.1B/op. Preserve all per-fork/per-iteration allocation samples. No allocation saving inferred from code size or older candidates.

compiler_evidence.timed: Uninstrumented compiler behavior apart from standard JMH GC profiling; retain actual JMH VM flags, version/blackhole mode and all iterations. No timed inline-tree assertion is inferred.
compiler_evidence.protocol: After all timing observations, only if phaseA calibration passed: fixed4096 calls to the same existing benchmark methods, WhiteBox-enqueue the benchmark root at level1 or4, verify actual installed level, fixed512 postcalls. No clocks/performance scores. LogCompilation/PrintInlining/targeted code only in these separate processes. C1optout three inputs xbefore/current/repair=9; C1nativeordinary,C2optoutordinary,C2nativeordinary xcurrent/repair=6. No source tuning or diagnostic retries.

runtime_budget.scope: Readiness/hash verification, up to196 fixed timing forks and15 fixed untimed compiler probes; offline analysis/preservation after runtime stops. One owned process group at a time.
runtime_budget.abort: Resource failure, timeout or interruption: retain partial output, HOLD, no restart/extension. Long calibration failure stops remaining runtime phases. After it passes, execute every remaining observation once without interim score-based stop or expansion.

qualification: ACCEPT only if every primary, regression, calibration, allocation and input/compile-evidence gate passes. Any failed, incomplete or inconclusive gate is HOLD. No hosted run, new install, public upload/push or PR3 promotion.
limits: Linuxx86-64 frozen Java images with repaired freshly built HotSpot overlay, not a fresh full JDK image pair or latest upstream-base qualification.

Same GCC16.2 release target/configuration apart from source-root/build-version metadata; existing current and repaired JVM binaries differ in layout. Whole-image effects are measured, not uniquely attributed to one source line.

C1timing is level1. Levels2/3 retain prior structural/correctness qualification, not new timing. Native-tiered timing and interpreter/C2 short/full-range cross-products omitted; no broad safety/portability claim.
Full-range input includes large/small values and signs; it is not a large-only dataset. Tiny subnormal-specific performance and constants are not newly qualified.
Original historical3x500ms cohort remains separate; no replacing its outcome with a favorable longer protocol.
